fit_reason: Whole 2016 Honda CR-V SUV listed by its private original owner.
findings: Headlight lenses on the front look slightly hazy and yellowed
Dusty, dull look on the dash plastics in front of the gauge cluster
Light road grime along the lower door sills and rocker area on both sides
No interior seat or cargo photos, so the tan cloth seats can't be judged
message: Hi Richard, we saw your listing for the white CR-V and it looks like it's been well cared for. The headlight lenses look a little hazy in the photos, and a wash and wax would bring the white paint up bright for buyers. We do pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a light interior clean, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
